title: Xelal buñ bind ci xam-xam
intro: Xalaatal sudoon danga taxaw ci wetu nit ku ñu xamul ci kéemtaan yu mag wala buur, waaye ci kàddu yuy jiite xol yi ba leegi. Jaamu Yàlla bi jotna kado bu am solo, mu sotti ngërëm ci bépp xelal buñu jox benn xale bu bëgg lool.
clues: Yallah daf ma jox xel, digal na ma ci ngërëm.
Ma waxtaan ak sama doom ci xel mu dal, artu ko ci mbëggeel ak xalaat.
Ma wax sama doom ni bokk ak Yàlla njuumte lu rëy la.
Ma digal sama doom mu ñaan, digal lu baax, tere lu bon, muñ.
Ma artu sama doom mu baña wëlbatiku ci réy-réy, mu baña dox ci kaw suuf ci réy-réy.
Jàngale naa sama doom mu baña yëngu, ba noppi wàññi baat bi, ndax baat bi gëna tar mooy yuuxu mbaam xuux.

identity.label: Man Kan laa?
options: Dhul-Kifl malaad bi
Luqman boroom xam-xam bi
Ku góor ci ñaari jardin yi
Tubba buur bi
Khidr le guide

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
